WITH claimable AS (
    SELECT d.id
    FROM agent_v3.dialogs d
    WHERE d.status = 'done'
      AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(d.final_result, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND (
            COALESCE(
                (d.metadata ->> 'completion_notify_pending')::boolean,
                FALSE
            ) = TRUE
            OR (
                d.metadata ->> 'completion_notify_sent_at' IS NULL
                AND d.finished_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 minutes'
            )
          )
      AND (
            d.metadata ->> 'completion_notify_locked_at' IS NULL
            OR (d.metadata ->> 'completion_notify_locked_at')::timestamptz
                 < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
          )
    ORDER BY d.finished_at ASC, d.id ASC
    LIMIT 20
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
),
claimed AS (
    UPDATE agent_v3.dialogs d
    SET
        metadata =
            COALESCE(d.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'completion_notify_pending', TRUE,
                'completion_notify_locked_at', NOW(),
                'completion_notify_last_claim_at', NOW()
            ),
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE d.id IN (SELECT id FROM claimable)
    RETURNING
        d.id AS dialog_id,
        d.airtable_dialog_id,
        d.airtable_task_id,
        d.person_name,
        d.telegram_username,
        d.summary,
        d.final_result,
        d.finished_at,
        COALESCE(d.metadata ->> 'completion_reason', 'other') AS completion_reason
)
SELECT *
FROM claimed
ORDER BY finished_at ASC, dialog_id ASC;

UPDATE agent_v3.dialogs
SET
    metadata =
        (
          COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
          - 'completion_notify_locked_at'
        )
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'completion_notify_pending', FALSE,
            'completion_notify_sent_at', NOW()
        ),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $('Prepare Completion Admin Notice').item.json.dialog_id }}
RETURNING
    id AS dialog_id,
    airtable_dialog_id,
    metadata ->> 'completion_notify_sent_at' AS completion_notify_sent_at;
